title: Crosswalk row
description: One mapping between a program control and a framework criterion. The direction is controls → criteria. Carries a mapping status that gates what the audit-surface publish will accept.

framework.description: Profile slug, e.g. nist-csf-2, soc2, pci-dss, iso-27001.

criterion.description: The criterion/clause id within the framework. Never licensed text.

mapping_status.description: proposed (agent), derived (from doctrine), validated (human). The auditor surface refuses unvalidated rows.
